_note: Per-photo metadata, keyed by the raw filename (without extension). optimize-photos.mjs merges this into data/photos.json, in this key order (which is also gallery order — the numeric filename prefix). Sequence is deliberate: water -> landscape -> golf -> W&L. Matthew: refine titles/locations freely.
